title: CSVToCSVW

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They want to understand what CSVToCSVW does, how it annotates columns, what the output looks like.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: The multi-block CSV format, how unit annotations work from bracket notation, the 4 endpoints, real CSVW output for a known example.
steps: What CSVToCSVW does — CSV → CSVW JSON-LD with QUDT unit annotations
Multi-block CSV format — metadata rows, blank separator, data table
Column header notation — bracket notation [mm] → unit:MilliM, suffix notation _MPa → unit:MegaPA
QUDT unit mapping table — at least 5 examples
Inline CSVW JSON-LD snippet from example2.csv — showing column annotations
Four endpoints table with curl examples
Real-world examples: IOFMaterialsTutorial, BAMresearch DF-TEM-PAW, CSVToCSVW examples/

live_api_calls: POST https://csvtocsvw.matolab.org/api/annotate?return_type=json-ld with data_url pointing to example2.csv

inline_assets_required.description: CSVW JSON-LD snippet from example2.csv: columns MaschineMm→unit:MilliM, KraftKn→unit:KiloN, Mx840A0Ch5C→unit:DEG_C, ZeitS→unit:SEC. With oa:Annotation entries.
curl POST /api/annotate with example2.csv URL. Already in page.
QUDT unit annotation examples: at least 5 rows. Column header → unit IRI.

walkthrough_requirements.expected: CSVW JSON-LD file with column annotations including qudt:unit IRIs

quality_gate: Bracket notation and suffix notation both explained with examples
QUDT unit table with at least 5 column→unit pairs
Inline CSVW JSON-LD snippet with real column names from example2.csv
4 API endpoints documented with curl examples
Real-world examples section with at least 3 datasets
